1. [ASSISTANT_SAID] A DAO (Decentralized Autonomous Organization) can be structured as an LLC (Limited Liability Company).
2. [ASSISTANT_SAID] An LLC can act as a legal representative of the DAO.
3. [ASSISTANT_SAID] The LLC will protect its members from personal liability related to the affairs of the DAO.
4. [ASSISTANT_SAID] The LLC provides privacy for its members.
5. [ASSISTANT_SAID] The creation of an LLC does not centralize the membership of a DAO.
6. [ASSISTANT_SAID] An LLC simply provides a legal identity to the DAO.
7. [ASSISTANT_SAID] Opening a bank account and obtaining an EIN for an LLC can be done through the LexDAO Clinic or online.
8. [ASSISTANT_SAID] Taxes for the LLC are handled by the KALI team.
9. [ASSISTANT_SAID] Annual reports and K-1s for LLC members can be handled by the LexDAO Clinic.
10. [ASSISTANT_SAID] Onboarding investors should respect local law and regulations.
11. [ASSISTANT_SAID] It is recommended to retain counsel when onboarding investors.
12. [ASSISTANT_SAID] Automated investor onboarding processes are available in partnership with kycDAO.
13. [ASSISTANT_SAID] KALI provides open source legal forms for self-certification of investors in private sales.
